production.note: US model years. First: MBUSA pricing release: "Arriving in U.S. dealerships in spring 2024 and starting at $83,900, the 2024 AMG C 63 S E PERFORMANCE ...". Still on sale: mbusa.com lists the 2026 AMG C 63 S E PERFORMANCE Sedan (mbusa-2026-c63-se).

body.note: mbusa.com lists the car as the 'AMG C 63 S E PERFORMANCE Sedan'. No other body of this variant is sold in the US.

configuration.note: 'Handcrafted AMG 2.0L inline-4 w/electric exhaust-gas turbocharger and rear 150kW electric motor'

displacementL.note: 1,991 cc per Sports Car Digest's technical data table (sportscardigest-c63-se): "Displacement 1991 cc". MBUSA states '2.0L'.

aspiration.note: One electric exhaust-gas turbocharger: 'inline-4 w/electric exhaust-gas turbocharger'

fuel.note: Plug-in hybrid with a rear-axle electric motor and a '400-volt AMG high-performance battery' of 6.1 kWh (MBUSA pricing release).

transmission.note: 'AMG SPEEDSHIFT® MCT 9-speed' (wet start-up clutch automatic, recorded as Automatic as in the W205 C 63 records). The rear electric motor has its own 'electrically-shifted two-speed gearbox' (MBUSA pricing release).

powerHp.note: Combined system output. Quote (mbusa.com, 2026 model): "671 hp @ 6,750 rpm". Same rating at launch, MBUSA pricing release for the 2024 model (mbusa-c63-se-pricing): "a 671 hp combined system output and 752 lb-ft combined system torque".

weightLb.note: US curb weight, sedan, 9-speed MCT (the only transmission), 2026 model. Quote (mbusa.com): "Curb weight 4,817 lbs"; no estimate label. No MBUSA weight for the 2024 or 2025 model was found, so the reference year is 2026, the earliest year with a qualifying weight under the 671 hp rating (unchanged since 2024). Mercedes-Benz Canada lists '2,165 kg' (4,773 lb), a different market (mbca-c63-se); the European figure is 2,111 kg EU (sportscardigest-c63-se).
